payload.description_html: Cervical vertebrae showing putative origin site of Mm. levator scapulae (if present) and serratus profundus in Erketu ellisoni (IGM 100/1803; C3 and C4 reversed from right). The arrow denotes the lateral surface of the diapophysis-rib complex where Mm. levator scapulae and serratus profundus would have been attached.
